tooltip.shouyun_workshop.glass_hammer.3: Shards damage nearby creatures and the wielder
tooltip.shouyun_workshop.netherite_hamme: Heavy strikes create a small blast and shockwave
Its own shockwave cannot launch the wielder
Recoil briefly numbs the wielder's hand
Press N to toggle block destruction
tooltip.shouyun_workshop.whirlwind_slash: Right-click for a three-block whirlwind slash
Take off after standing still for two seconds; WASD controls direction
tooltip.shouyun_workshop.wind_flight: Cannot descend while flying; costs one hunger point every seven seconds
